Description: 1. Correspondence between Taoiseach Leo Varadkar, his staff, and Minister for Children Katherine Zappone, or her advisers, or Dept of Children & Youth Affairs (D/CYA) officials, on the topic of Scouting Ireland, between 1st May to 18th May 2020. 2. All correspondence to Taoiseach Leo Varadkar on the following topic: The coronavirus crisis and the horse racing industry. The correspondence could include but is not limited to items to/from Horse Racing Ireland, horse trainers and owners, race courses, politicians and the betting industry. The time period can be limited to March 1, 2020 to May 21, 2020.

Any memos prepared for attention of the Taoiseach relating to communication strategy for handling the COVID 19 pandemic. Correspondence between civil servants relating to the creation of aforementioned memos. Minutes and agendas of any meetings with the Taoiseach relating to the communication strategy for handling the COVID 19 pandemic. Correspondence with the Taoiseach relating to the communication strategy for handling the COVID-19 pandemic.

All correspondence between the Taoiseach’s office and private individuals, businesses, State agencies, government figures and any other stakeholders the regarding: The cancellation/postponement of horse racing events due to Covid-19 · The resuming of horse racing as part of the roadmap to lift Covid-19 restrictions.
Copies of the most recent three staff surveys of the Dept of the Taoiseach and reports on the results.

1. Any correspondence, reports, files, submissions, minutes of meetings or conversations, that were created, received or exchanged by the Taoiseach or any of his officials above the grade of principal officer and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen or any of her officials above the civil service grade of AD 14 on the topic of: (a) Brexit, (b) the European Green Deal or (c) the Covid-19 pandemic. 2. Any correspondence, reports, files, submissions, minutes of meetings or conversations, that were created, received or exchanged by the Taoiseach or any his officials above the grade of principal officer and European Council President Charles Michel or any of his officials above the civil service grade of AD 14 on the topic of: (a) Brexit, (b) the European Green Deal or (c) the Covid-19 pandemic. The time period I am interested in is from November 1, 2019 to June 9, 2020.

All correspondence between the Department of Public Expenditure secretary general Robert Watt and the secretaries general of the Departments of the Taoiseach, Health, Social Protection and Business regarding Covid-19 and the government response between the period 01 March 2020 and 11 June 2020.

1. Any record, including but not limited to minutes, of any meeting held or communication between the Taoiseach and/or his officials, and any member or representative of the Licensed Vintners Association (the LVA) and/or the Vintners' Federation of Ireland (the VFI) from 1 February 2020 to present. 2. Any record prepared in advance of, or subsequent to, a meeting referred to at item 1above for the purposes of preparing for such a meeting, briefing a participant at such a meeting, analysing the outcome of such a meeting, or otherwise referable to such a meeting. 3. Any record, including but not limited to minutes, of any meeting held or communication between the Taoiseach and/or his officials, and any member of the Oireachtas, or a member of their staff or their representative, from 1 February 2020 to present relating to and/or referring to both Covid-19 or and/or the coronavirus, as well as the actual or potential closure of public houses. 4. Any record prepared in advance of, or subsequent to a meeting referred to at item 3 above for the purposes of preparing for such a meeting, briefing a participant at such a meeting, analysing the outcome of such a meeting, or otherwise referable to such a meeting. 5. Any record considering, analysing, assessing or recommending the closure of public houses related to the Covid-19 Pandemic.

The release of correspondence sent by members of the public to the Taoiseach between March and May regarding the government's response to the Covid-19 pandemic. I am conscious that this may be too broad a request, so am satisfied to receive a sample of 50 pieces of correspondence should that be the case.
All correspondence sent and received between the Taoiseach and the Secretary General of the Department of the Taoiseach, and either Facebook, Apple, or Google, between 1st March and 22nd June 2020.

The release of any email correspondence between the Taoiseach (or his secretary) and officials regarding his speeches/addresses to the nation about Covid-19. I am specifically looking for emails containing notes, comments, or other suggestions to speeches delivered by the Taoiseach on 12 March, 17 March, 27 March, 1 May, 15 May, 5 June and 19 June. The 'officials' referred to include the Taoiseach's speechwriter Patrick Geoghegan, his chief of staff Brian Murphy, the government press secretary and the Taoiseach's advisers.
Copies of any correspondence received by the department seeking a Taoiseach's nomination to the Seanad. This request to cover the period 1 January 2020 to date of receipt of the request.

Copies of records, in the Department of an Taoiseach consisting of communications between Fine Gael's LGBT Committee and the Taoiseach and Office of Taoiseach in 2018, 2019 and in 2020 to today’s date.

All correspondence received by the Taoiseach and/or the Taoiseach's office relating to the New Children's Hospital from January 1 2020 to date. All correspondence between Professor Brendan Drumm and the Taoiseach from January 1 2019 to date.

I am now seeking records under the FOI act for all records in the Department of An Taoiseach relating to Taoiseach Varadkar's statement, in 2018, pledging to keep politics out of decisions on the health care of transgender people in Ireland and to follow the best most up to date advice and any records relating to any discussions in the department, subsequent to the Taoiseach’s statement, dealing with and or relating to the health care of transgender people. My FOI is exclusively for records within the Department of An Taoiseach and for your convenience I am showing a reference to the aforementioned Times article: https://www.thetimes.co.uk/article/varadkar-vows-to-keep-politics-out-of-trans-decisions-5qm9gsscx
A copy of all correspondence/documents relating to ministerial appointments from June 26, 2020, to date.

A spreadsheet/database/record of all costs incurred by your Department incurred as part of Ireland's bid to secure a seat on the UN Security Council. This record to include a line by line account of expenditure associated with the bid.

Copies of all receipts/invoices related to planned visit by the Taoiseach and any other members of his staff or officials from his Department to Davos in January 2020. Copies of any correspondence received or sent relating to the arrangement of travel for the Taoiseach and delegation to Davos.
Copies of all correspondence between the Department of Finance, the Department of Taoiseach and the board (NPHDB) of the new children’s hospital. This should span from January 2020 to date.

A copy of all communications received by the Taoiseach (or the department) relating to Minister Barry Cowen's driving ban - or any related topics - since June 27, 2020, to present. I would like to seek the following information. The period to which my request refers to is 6 May 2016 to 31 May 2017. The correspondence should include all correspondence or communication, sent by email, text message, Whatsapp, letter or any other format, between January 1, 2020 to date of the receipt of the request.
All correspondence to the Taoiseach from TDs and Senators regarding the Covid-19 restrictions from the period 01 May 2020 to the present day.

I request the briefing document for Taoiseach Micheál Martin, and other ministers in his department, files usually given to a minister informing them of what will be in their department, what roles or responsibilities they have and what issues lie ahead under a new government. This request is made under the Freedom of Information legislation and covers the period since when the government was formed.

Copies of correspondence to/from An Taoiseach Micheál Martin and the following politicians: - Tánaiste Leo Varadkar - Foreign Affairs Minister Simon Coveney - Climate Action Minister Eamon Ryan - Media Minister Catherine Martin - Agriculture Minister Dara Calleary - Sinn Féin leader Mary Lou McDonald TD - Labour leader Alan Kelly TD - Social Democrats co-leader Catherine Murphy - Social Democrats co-leader Róisín Shortall The timeframe for the correspondence can be limited to the period June 27, 2020 to July 22 2020. I am also seeking copies of any documents attached to correspondence to/from the politicians listed.

Copies of correspondence to/from An Taoiseach Micheál Martin and the following organisations: Google Apple Facebook Twitter Microsoft Amazon Intel Web Summit The timeframe for the correspondence can be limited to the period June 27, 2020 to July 22 2020. I am also seeking copies of any documents attached to correspondence.

A datadump of the financial management system that is used for recording costs associated with the IBRC Commission of Investigation for the calendar year 2019 and thus far in 2020. Copies of any correspondence between the Commission and the Department of the Taoiseach with regard to running costs for the commission of investigation. When considering all parts of this request, I would ask that you pay close attention to Section 42(e)(ii)(B) of the FOI Act.

Details of any purchases of computer equipment, mobile equipment, tablets, laptops, any mobile or computer accessories, any electrical equipment or appliances on behalf of An Taoiseach or any minister of state at your Department in period between 1 May 2020 and the current date. Copies of the response that was issued in any such instance. Copies of any receipts or invoices associated with the above.
